Name: MAP_GRID_CREATE_HEIGHT_LIMIT_DETAIL_INFO_PARAM_ST
Description: While the player is in a given map grid block, marks listed LOD2 blocks as high or low ground. Each loaded block switches its assets between their high and low versions by this state; it's updated when the player moves into a block with a different row. Separate from MapGridCreateHeightLimitInfoParam (which decides by the player's height whether a grid loads). Retail: m61 (Land of Shadow) only.

Fields.Name: Current Grid Block ID
Fields.Description: Block the player must be in for the row to apply, as 8 digits AAXXYYLL (m61_48_48_00: 61484800, m61_24_24_01: 61242401). The player's LOD0 block is tried first, then its LOD1 and LOD2 parents, so a LOD0 row wins over an overlapping LOD1 or LOD2 row. If several rows have the same value, the first is used.

Fields.Name: Target LOD2 Grid 00
Fields.Description: LOD2 block set by this row, as 4 digits XXYY (m61_11_11_02: 1111); its high/low state is Is High Place 00. 0: empty slot. A loaded block whose LOD2 block is not listed counts as low.
